name: daoris-workspace
description: Workspace root. The publishable CLI is src/Daoris.Cli; nothing here is published.

scripts.prepare: node tools/merge-rows.mjs --install && node tools/merge-backlog.mjs --install && node tools/index-hook.mjs --install
scripts.verify: npm run verify:checks && npm run verify:tests
scripts.check:web-rules: node tools/contracts.mjs --if-stale && node tools/test-sets.mjs run web-rules
scripts.test:web: npm run test:web:unit && npm run test:web:e2e
scripts.test:web:e2e: npm --prefix src/Daoris.Web run build && node tools/tree-base.mjs build src/Daoris.Service/Daoris.Service.Http && npm --prefix src/Daoris.Web run e2e
